answer: Copper tally bond: each identity carves a copper tally stick, splits it, keeps half, deposits half in a registry, bonded 70 credits. The deposited half bears a yarrow seal. Each epoch an auditor checks the kept half against the entry. A missing, mismatched, or reused half burns the bond, leaving an ember record. The k-th tally costs 30+5(k-1) credits, so 1,000 fakes pay 2,527,500 plus 70,000 locked bonds for a 40k pool; honest agents pay 30.
